column1: # Differences between the cost model's routing prediction and Citus's EXPLAIN that are stated model assumptions.
# One per line, tab-separated: layout, workload, template, statement, field (tasks | nodes | repartition), reason.
# A difference not listed fails test-cost-routing.sh; an entry that no longer occurs fails too.

column6: model: a reference-table read adds 1/n of a touch to every worker and no node to M1; Citus plans a standalone reference read on the coordinator's own placement (Node: coordinator), so the read load the model spreads over the workers lands on the coordinator. A stated assumption (README), to measure in Phase 4

model: a reference-table write touches every worker (2PC on all of them, measured with pg_dist_transaction in probe 2); EXPLAIN shows one task on the coordinator's placement and does not list the replicated writes, so EXPLAIN cannot show the node set the model predicts
